Does the Incoterm match your sales contract?

Incoterms 2000^ which are published by the International Chamber of Commerce^ determine where the costs and responsibilities of the seller end and where they begin for the buyer. Incoterms specify the method of shipment^ who is paying the freight^ and who is buying the insurance.

Does the method of shipment agree with your sales contract? Are the ports/airports of loading and discharge acceptable? Is a negotiable bill of lading versus a non-negotiable bill of lading addressed correctly? These are critical issues that need to be correct in the LC.

if it is screw feeder of solid fuel hag^ check the bulk density. If the material is very light like rice husk^ the screw must be bigger size than std screw.check fuel if it is rice husk or low bulk density fuel.
for tertiary heat exchanger^ the side rows and top rows are ss . Check this carefully.

when the material to be conveyed is rice husk or very low bd^ the screw should be trough type so that top cover can be kept open to avoid compression. For rice husk (bd140 kg/m3)^ use large screw with more free flights. That means increase the pitch of each next flight by higher margin than normal. Do not give top cover to the screw or give the straight height much more and then cover so that compression does not take place.
For finned tube quality checking^ use check list number 501 seperately. This check may have completed if tubes are received by our factory. But needs check if inspection is not done.
if any doubt or non complience of any point^ call up the seniors and get cleared before proceeding further.
for heat exchanger application^ the pipe should be checked for physical parameters also for good weldability. Onlty chemical test is not enough.
do not open drain valve in feed piping if the pid loop is ON. if drain valve needs to be open^ take feed pump speed in manula mode and then stabilise manually before putting on the pid loop again

do not use rubber gasket or low temperature gaskets if the piping is jacketed or liquid temperature is going to increase above atm temp. We may tend to use available rubber gasket from client ^ but it will melt.
Check if there is door at the bottom portion of bucket elevator to clean any material stored there during operation. This door should be just below the granules inlet.

There is cleaning door at bottom portion of bucket elevator just below material inlet. Open it and clean material inside. Do this regularly every shift by stopping rav for some time and reducing nozzle pressure.
Ford cup to measure liquid viscosity
Interlock diagram with at points mentioned on it
Personal protection equipments like helmet^ goggles^ shoes^ handglves
Catalog of vfd^ pid^ pressure transmitter etc
Decide bags to be installed or not. Bags should not be installed till water trial and Alarm interlocks are checked
Before starting screw^ open the bearing block conver. Call fitter and ensure that the lock nut is tightened properly. This is must.

screw should be emptied and cleaned after shutdown. If not^ the material inside screw becomes hard and when you start again^ the screw flights get damaged and also shaft can bend. True for all screws but more observed in feed screws of sfd wet feed

For feed screw of flash dryer^ check that the screw should not enter inside the duct otherwise air flow will get disturbed. If the screw has entered inside ventury or duct^ talk to design office and get cleared on what to do.

flights pitch should gradually increase in area where feed enters. it is important that the next flight pitch should be same or bigger than previous flight. Next flight pitch can not be smaller than previous in any screw. Check last pitch carefully.
The scrubber section^ feed section or any liquid section takes time to arrest flange leakages. So we must start pumps first as soon as control panel is charged so we get time to complete leakages.

when there is tubing between the equipment and pressure transmitter^ ensure that the threading at PT or instrument end is not leaking. If it leaks^ the fluid from equipment will flow towards PT and PT or instrument will burn.
Use metallic tubing if temperature is going to be high during operation.

When Siemens plc and win cc scada: while opening screen^ it stops in between and does not open^ then open windows^ go to search engine^ write ' reset_wincc.vbs' and then enter. This will clean scada and start it again.

bottom frame and top frame of base are connected to each other by welded angle piece till the commissioning. Cut these pieces so that vibration isolators take the load. Ensure this before start of blower.
Solid fuel hag^ ensure that the channels on top of hag for hanging  bricks modules are parallal to reach other.
Fir solid fuel direct fired hag^ ensure that the channels on top of ash cyclone for hanging  bricks modules are parallal to reach other.

For slow firing of brick  lining for  solid fuel hag^ client needs about 2 ton wood or equivalent fuel. This referance is for 60 lac kcal per hour capacity furnace. For other sizes^ make the wood quantity proportionate and inform client.

If suspensibility is low in product extruded granules^ the client has to look into particle size before making dough before extruder. If the grinding of dry material is proper before dough making^ suspensibility will be good even if inlet temp is higher.

Atm sd:Sometimes the moisture is product increases and does not reduce even after increasing outlet temperature.  That time we have too check atomizer holes.  When atomizer holes are blocked^  the product moisture increases.  Also check liquid distributor
scrubber pump 1 should be always ON otherwise frp shall get damaged. so ensure that the id fan and fd fan and combustion fan and fuel  stops when scrubber 1 stops
if cyclone outlet is double flap valve then put plastic sheet and wrap both actiuators . otherwise actuators get damaged due to powder and moisture. If it is rotary valve^ follow the sae for motor
check flap valve smooth operation and confirm. because it always gives problem during plant operation
if pid make is same^ get pid values from ramesh for panoli setp spray dryer and hag and put them to start with
check all motor interlocks by using onlcy control section. you can keep power mcb off.
check all process interlocks like temperature high and pressure high by changing set points for checking
check direction of rotation of all motors
make all vfd setting 60 hz max
Check screw conveyor of hag. The rpm may have to be changed like all other sites.
In VFD make toque boost function ON in vfd of feed screw pump and  hag screw
check whether scr nozzle is there in ventury scrubber pipe in ventury
All fans belts should be tightened.
check atomiser bept is tight or not .
is spare belt of atomiser avilable ?
check lock plates for all pulley
Always keep chamber door open while starting I'd fan for testing. Otherwise chamber can get damaged due to high vaccum.
feed pump should never run dry
atomiser oil level should be meintained
outlet temperature goes very high^ can burn id fan bellow
Sfd: If less air flow is kept in spin flash dryer plant^ feed material may stick inside the agitator due to very low velocity
Sfd: If less air flow is kept in spin flash dryer plant^ feed material may stick inside the agitator due to very low velocity

Sfd: When we handle cake material in feed bin of sfd^ if feed bin speed is high^ the cake amy get pasty due to high rpm. This change is due to homogenisation due to high agitation of cake. So rduce speed to maintain cake free flowing
ask PH of the feed. if ph is very acidic^ then equipments will get worn off. This is important to check ph everytime while starting plant
If suddenly id fan starts taking high current and vaccum in equipemt drops to positive^ check rupture discs. When rupture disc opens in previous equipment^ if fan takes high current.

If the bag filter/cycone is getting high pressure drop and bags getting choked soon^ check the site flow is very high. Other indication of high air flow is inlet temperature is lower than design. So reduce air flow and increase inlet temperature.

Spd/sfd : there is centrifuge and a screw between centrifuge and dryer and dryer inlet screw. So there should be interlock of motors.  First dryer starts^ then screws between centrifuge and dryer^  and centrifuge. Otherwise dryer will chock with wet.
Check belts of agitator and the motor are not loose. If belts are loose^ they will break after some time. So tighten the belts properly before starting the spin flash dryer.

If cable is removed for any reason and connected again and if i.e. R^ y^ b cables are not connected to same terminal^ there is chance of change in direction of rotation if motor. This connection change can be at motor or at terminal strip of panel.

In granulation plants wherein the scrubber water is directly taken to feed tank^ ensure that no water is added. Operator adds water for some reason but it reduces plant capacity drastically. water is added for reducing particle size^ so check

do not open drain valve in piping. it will disturb the pid loop stability of feed loop. Therefore if necessary to open drain valve^ take pid on manual mode and then do re-stabilisation manually before putting on pid loop again.
do not use rubber gasket or low temperature gaskets if the liquid tem is going to increase. We may tend to use available rubber gasket from client ^ but it will melt.

In situations where superheated steam is to be used^ We provide desuperheating bank to reduce the temperature to saturation teamperature. With this we extract specific heat from superheated steam.

after the condensate comes out of main condensation bank^ the condensate at high temperature is converted to flash steam and low temperature condensate. Instead of discharging the condensate^ we use this flash steam and high temperature condensate in separate preheter bank. This reduces the steam consumption by up to between 15 to 25 % depending upon steam details.
there is expansion of tubes when the temperature of tube increases. We provide for free expansion of tubes and hence the life of heat exchanger is very long compaired to conventional heat exchanger.

The enite steam heater design including tube sheet are analysed for temperature and pressure. The design is checked with through calculations. Further to validate the calculations^ we simulate this through Worldclass CFD modelling (Ansys). This ensures flawless design.

Our established quality control system works from design stage to manufacturing including for raw materials^ despatch stage^ installation and commissining. With systematci check lists and documentation. Ensuring flawless execution.
We select steam trap and check it for various criticle points^ specifically stall point phenomenon is checked. The systematic design ensures smooth execution.

The control valve selection is for the range of operation^ shutdown and startup timing. The in operation percentage opening is selected for efficient operation. This is done thoruhg established formats and check lists.

We provide provide separate desuperheating bank and separate condensate and flash steam heat recovery banks. This takes care of hammering effect during operation of steam heater. When hammering is avoided^ the life of steam heater increases to very long duration.
Because free expansion of tube is possible^ the stresses on steam heater body are avoided. The maintaince related issues are completely taken care of due to this design feature.
